title: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
abstract: arXiv:2611.25197v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.

translated_title: 从自博弈强化学习到约束控制：使用DAgger蒸馏DiffMPC学生模型
translated_abstract: 自博弈强化学习（RL）能够产生强大的驾驶策略，但这些策略难以验证或解释。可微分模型预测控制（DiffMPC）可以强制执行显式约束，但通常需要通过模仿记录数据或代价高昂的强化学习来训练。为了向已训练好的策略添加约束，我们保留了PPO教师模型的骨干网络，并将其动作头替换为强制执行道路边界半平面和智能体椭圆约束的DiffMPC。随后，我们在教师的自博弈仿真器中使用DAgger对学生模型进行蒸馏。在9个随机种子上的实验表明，由较小教师模型蒸馏出的受约束学生在nuPlan上与教师持平，在CARLA和分布外的Waymo场景上超过了教师。对于更强的教师模型，学生在nuPlan和Waymo上的失败次数更少，同时在CARLA上保持同等水平。其蒸馏过程耗时不超过教师训练时间的30%。
tldr: 该方法通过保留PPO教师骨干并用强制执行显式约束的DiffMPC替换其动作头，再借助DAgger在教师自博弈仿真器中蒸馏学生模型，成功为已训练的自博弈RL驾驶策略添加约束，学生性能持平甚至超越教师，且蒸馏耗时不超过教师训练时间的30%。
en_tdlr: The method adds explicit constraints to an already trained self-play RL driving policy by keeping the PPO teacher's backbone and replacing its action head with a constraint-enforcing DiffMPC, then distilling students via DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator, achieving matching or superior performance on nuPlan, CARLA, and Waymo within no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.
